catalog.summary: Chat message with author, bubble and actions.

patternAbsent.reason: There is no Authoring Practices pattern for a message in a conversation. Each message is an `article`, the element the Feed Pattern gives each entry and the one a screen reader jumps between; its controls follow the Button pattern.

rootPartReason: A bubble nests inside a message and both belong to one family. Two roots written `data-part="root"` under one `data-ui` would make every selector for the row match the surface inside it, so the bubble's root is written `data-part="bubble"`.

roles.group: none; a div around consecutive articles of one sender
roles.quote: none, or button when it asks to jump to the quoted message
roles.activity-step: none; the current step carries aria-current="step"
roles.retry: button, named for what it resends

labelling.typing: aria-label from the typing message; a written aria-label wins
labelling.receipt: the status word, visible or in a visually hidden span

inferenceReason: A message at the end is the reader's own, and every surveyed chat paints it in the accent; a thread paints no box. The binding resolves it and writes `data-variant` and `data-tone`, so the DOM always states the painting and a consumer's explicit value still wins.

receipt.inside: bubble › meta, beside the hour, at the end of the last line
receipt.word: visually hidden inside a bubble, read by assistive technology

readInk.solid: the tone's on-solid ink at full strength

receipt.failed: a word in the footer, in the danger ink, lined up with the surface's edge; no mark
receipt.outsideBubble: a word in the footer, with no mark
receipt.reason: A mark beside a twelve-pixel word under the bubble read as two voices saying one thing and never shared a center line. Inside the bubble the hour and the mark share one box of the line's height (WhatsApp, Telegram); the reviewer rejected the caption under the bubble.

states.complete: a tick in the success ink, words in the muted ink
states.current: the shared ring and a band of light across the words

activity.reducedMotion: the ring keeps its track and the band stops; the words stand in the plain ink
activity.reason: ReUI's `c-message-7` draws one muted line that pulses. A log of steps says what has been done, not only that something is being done; a single step is the same card with one line.

streaming.arrival: each arrival is split into words; every word is in the DOM at once and its paint enters after a delay of 28 ms per word, compressed so no word waits more than 320 ms
streaming.entrance: opacity 0 to 1 by 45 %, blur 0.25em to 0, over --slotted-duration-long
streaming.caretShape: a dot of round(0.6em, 2px), breathing between scale 1 and 0.72 over --slotted-duration-loop
streaming.replacement: text that does not extend the previous replaces it at once
streaming.reducedMotion: every arrival lands settled; the dot stands lit
streaming.busy: aria-busy on the root while sending or streaming
streaming.reason: A transport serves a reply in bursts: a word, a pause, forty words. Painted as received, the burst lands as a block and the eye reads blocks. The family paints each burst as a short wave without holding any received word back from the DOM; the wave never trails the transport by more than 320 ms. The reviewer rejected the blinking bar and the block landing.

group.avatarColumn: reserved in every row of a group that holds an avatar, by `:has()`
group.corners: consecutive bubbles flatten the corner on the sender's side to --slotted-radius-sm
group.reason: shadcn asks for an empty avatar slot in every earlier row; Chatscope asks for a position prop per message. A run is a shape the stylesheet can read from the DOM.

actionsVisibility.always: the actions are painted at rest
actionsVisibility.hover: the actions appear on hover, on focus inside the message, and always under `(hover: none)`
actionsVisibility.reason: A reveal by hover alone hides the actions from the keyboard and from a touch screen.

versions.label: the versionLabel message, with {current} and {total}
versions.mirrored: the previous control turns the chevron, and a right-to-left document turns both
versions.boundary: the previous control is disabled at the first version and the next one at the last; no wrap

quote.author: quote-author
quote.jump: a quote with `onJump` (React) or `(jump)` (Angular) is a button that asks the page to scroll to the quoted message

clamp.measured: the binding shows `more` only while the content overflows its clamp, read by a ResizeObserver
clamp.reason: Truncation never removes content: the whole text stays in the DOM for copying, finding in the page and assistive technology.

reactions.placement: straddles the bubble's lower edge on the sender's side; the bubble reserves half of the row's height below it
reactions.reason: shadcn's row hangs three quarters outside the bubble and its example needs a 32-pixel gap so the row does not land on the next message.

keyboard.effect: moves to the next target: a reaction, the more control, a quote that jumps, an action, a version control
moves to the previous target under the same rule
on a version control, shows the next version; the previous one in a right-to-left document; no wrap
on a version control, shows the previous version; the next one in a right-to-left document; no wrap

rovingReason: A message holds up to six targets and a conversation holds hundreds; a composite with arrow keys would hide the actions behind a mode, which is what `attachment` and `list-item` decided for the same shape.

attachments.reason: A file in a message is `attachment`, placed in the body: `<MessageBody><AttachmentGroup>…</AttachmentGroup><Bubble>…</Bubble></MessageBody>`.

editing.reason: Editing a sent message is the composer's field in the bubble's place: `{editing ? <Textarea defaultValue={text} /> : <Bubble>…</Bubble>}`. Whether a message is being edited belongs to the product.

emptyState.reason: A conversation with no messages is the page's result state: `{messages.length ? <MessageScroller>…</MessageScroller> : <ResultState status="empty" … />}`.

systemMessage.reason: A line the system writes (someone joined, a call ended) is a separator or an activity row of `message-scroller`, not a message with no sender.

typewriter.reason: Ant Design X replays received text at a pace of its own. The transport already streams; a family that holds text back shows less than it has.

stateModelReason.current: The version of a reply on screen: which alternative the reader is on. `versionCount` says how many exist; the content of each is the consumer's.
stateModelReason.pressed: One reaction the reader has given. The count is the consumer's, from its store.
stateModelReason.revealed: A long bubble shown whole after it was clamped.

retry.placement: beside the surface on the side away from the sender, centerd on the last line
retry.reason: A red rim round an accent bubble read as a second, clashing bubble, and a faded fill dropped the white words under 4.5:1. The control beside the surface says the message did not go and is the way to send it again, as iMessage places it; the receipt says it in words.

meta.layout: a float at the end of the words: it shares the last line when there is room and takes a line of its own at the end when there is not
meta.ink: the bubble's ink at 90%, the lowest share that keeps 4.5:1 on every fill (4.50 on the dark accent)
meta.box: the line rounded down to an even length, so the 14-pixel digits and the 14-pixel mark center on whole pixels
